execution: Close t signal, next observed eligible open t+1 execution; mark at open t+2; no short, leverage, intraday stops or real orders; fractional theoretical units
gap_rule: Split before first accepted observation after each listed unresolved missing day; reset all rolling/state history. End prior episode at last observed open and restart after warmup. This is ex-post sample-boundary censoring, not an implementable pre-gap exit signal.

statistics.primary_family: 12 market-by-candidate primary-period net mean daily return differences versus MA200, cost10, one-sided positive, Holm
statistics.acceptance: Positive paired mean with lower 95% block CI above zero and Holm p<=0.05, positive paired mean also at cost25; report per-market and require subsequent independent validation. P3 drawdown control reported separately from alpha gate.

factor_diagnostics.metric: Within-market time-series Spearman correlation; ties retained; descriptive only, no IID significance claims; labels must end within evaluation period

blocked_text_candidates: T1 centered news mean times temporal news std
excluded_inputs: future turning point labels as features
currently known constituents backfilled to history
known_limits: History already seen and prior variants studied
Current-vintage OHLC, QQQ a1 not certified total return
Three non-investible indices simulated as theoretical units
Costs and cash return are assumptions, no tax/borrow/fill model
Correlated markets and short STAR50 history
Not a news sentiment factor replication
